item.title: Register for a mending class
item.context_text: You want to repair a jacket and a bag. You need to choose the right workshop and understand what to take.
item.objective_text: Choose a workshop and explain the equipment you will bring.
success_conditions: Choose a workshop and explain the equipment you will bring.

children.title: Read the situation
children.instructions: Read the information and answer both questions.
children.prompt_text:
SATURDAY WORKSHOPS
10:00 Mend a Jacket: bring a jacket with a tear. Needles and matching thread are supplied. 14:00 Repair a Bag: bring a cloth bag and your own thread. The afternoon class is full. To take the morning class, email your name and item by Friday at six.

questions.prompt: Which class can you still join?
questions.explanation: The afternoon class is full, so only the morning class is open.

questions.prompt: What must the registration email include?
options: Your name and which item you will bring
Your home address and phone number
The colour and price of your thread
questions.explanation: The notice asks for your name and the item.

children.title: Send your registration
children.prompt_text: Workshop organiser: Please send the booking details.
children.instructions: Give your name and say which damaged item you will bring.
children.model_answer: Hello, my name is Kamila Rahimova. Can I join the morning class? I'll bring my jacket with a torn pocket.

children.title: Check what's supplied
children.prompt_text: Friend: Do we need to buy anything for the morning class?
children.instructions: Say which materials are provided and what to take.
children.model_answer: They have needles and thread for us. You just need to bring a torn jacket.
